title: Influence of a motor-cognitive exercise program on cognitive performance, cancer-related fatigue and brain activity in pediatric oncology patients during the acute phase.
summary:
Das  vorliegenden Forschungsvorhaben soll den Einfluss eines kombinierten
motorisch-kognitiven Trainingsprogramms auf die kognitive Leistungsfähigkeit, die Cancer-related Fatigue und die Gehirnaktivität bei pädiatrisch-onkologischen Patient*innen in der Akutphase untersuchen.

interventions.name: Motor-cognitive training program: in the intervention group, a 5-week motor-cognitive movement-oriented program is integrated into the patients daily routine. The exercise program is conducted twice a week and ten times in total, both individually on the inpatient unit and online in a small group. T

Motor training: in the observation group, a 5-week motor exercise program is integrated into the patients' daily routine. These consist of a combination of strength, endurance and mobilization exercises (with and without small equipment).

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Patients with an oncological disease (ICD10 C00-C97), incl. relapse, who are undergoing inpatient or outpatient treatment and are receiving chemotherapeutic treatment. In the case of recurrence: The period between initial disease (last chemotherapy) and study inclusion must be at least two years
- Age: ≥ 7 <18 years
- Gender: Both male and female
- Medical confirmation that physical activity is possible
- Study start within the first chemotherapy cycle
- Written declaration of consent from the legal guardian and the study participant must be available
Exclusion criteria:
- Particular stressful/strenuous circumstances (based on medical recommendation)
- Severe physical and / or mental impairments that make participation in the motor-cognitive training session or assessments impossible from a medical point of view
- Severe chronic illnesses that prevent physical activity
- Lack of language comprehension that prevents understanding of the consent form or instructions
